posts.cooked:
Update:

If I can make it to Who's Yer Con 2013 at all, it will be in a limited capacity, as I'll be out of town most of the following week for PAX East.

There's no way the >G folks can make it to Who's Yer Con 2013, again because of PAX East the next week. I therefore see no reason to pursue getting a booth. That being said, I spoke to Bill at Arsenal about the prospect of combining forces with the Arsenal booth. Perhaps they could have a booth big enough to run a single game. Long shot, but not out of the question. If nothing else, Bill's probably happy to stock up on the games in the hopes that we send buyers to the Arsenal booth.

 

If there isn't a demo going on at the booth, or if we want a presence outside of dealer room hours, or if we want both, there's a choice of having a specific table (tables?!) set aside for us, or just claiming a table in the free-play area. 

 

I think our first question should probably be: Do we have enough people interested in running games to have a constant prescence? If not, what should we aim for?

 

The con appears to run from noon on Fri Mar 15 to 3pm on Sun Mar 17. Who would want to run games at what times?
